verdict.rationale: ObsessionDB documents that it runs the official ClickHouse engine with the same SQL, and that every existing ClickHouse query works unchanged, so its native SQL surface carries over without add-ons. However, the evidence never names the story's specific capabilities, so their presence rests only on the general compatibility claim. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of window functions, CTEs, JSON/semi-structured types, array types and functions, and rich date/time types, plus independent or hands-on corroboration.
